freeze_rule: Frozen at v1. Corrections or additions are published as explicit new versions (v2+); entries are never silently edited after freeze.

spec_source.ssot: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-life-manager-unified-ssot.md (origin/main a883c1f12), remaining-TODO item 5: freeze the EBA v1 90-evaluation manifest and per-dimension scores

source_atlas.description: The 90 existing systems in 14 families mapped by the EBA landscape article. The atlas file itself is not present on origin/main; it was retrieved verbatim from the article-pinned revision via the GitHub API and its blob SHA verified.

aggregation_rule: The 7 EBA families (Forecast / Sim / Intervention / Decision / Execution / Welfare / Generalization) are aggregated SEPARATELY. No single global score is computed or permitted from this manifest (SSOT remaining-TODO 5). Cross-family numbers are never averaged.

mapping_method.primary_family: Each of the 90 atlas entries is assigned exactly one primary EBA family by its dominant measured mechanism, so the 7 primary counts sum to 90.
mapping_method.secondary_membership: Entries whose evidence also serves another family carry eba_families_secondary; secondary membership is reported but never double-counted in the primary totals.
mapping_method.cross_cutting_seats: 17 entries are evaluation infrastructure, judge/grader machinery, or safety guardrails rather than direct family evidence. They are seated in the family of their dominant mechanism with mapping_seat=cross_cutting_* and must be reported as infrastructure/guardrails, not as family benchmark evidence.
mapping_method.development_seat: simile and aaru are seated primary=Sim (their object is a simulated population distribution) with secondary=Forecast (their headline claims are forecast-accuracy claims about human responses).

Forecast.definition: EBA-Forecast: binary outcomes and event probabilities scored with Brier or log loss, observed frequencies, calibration and reliability slices. A confident wrong forecast is penalized more heavily than an uncertain one. (EBA stack, manager-eba-evaluating-beneficial-action-en.md SS5)

Sim.definition: EBA-Sim: population distributions scored with total-variation distance, Wasserstein distances for ordered outcomes, subgroup errors and overdispersion. Always disclose the sampling frame and whether model access included future labels. (same source)

Intervention.definition: EBA-Intervention: predictions of differences under interventions, ideally with real trial contrasts and uncertainty. Causal ATE/CATE error only when ground truth is genuinely identified; pedagogical synthetic effects are labeled separately. (same source)

Decision.definition: EBA-Decision: policies comparing alternatives with sensible abstention, budget and permission compliance, expected utility, tail-risk controls and honest uncertainty. NO_ACTION is mandatory and may be optimal. (same source)

Execution.definition: EBA-Execution: whether a bounded, legitimate instruction changes the external world as intended, verified by external independent state, hash-linked receipts, idempotency, timeout and reconciliation. (same source)

Welfare.definition: EBA-Welfare: real people's negative affect, functioning, financial hardship, pain, security, freedom to act, service access and adverse events where appropriate and consented; requires independent measurement and a credible counterfactual. Never collapsed into one unsupported universal score. (same source)

Generalization.definition: EBA-Generalization: replication across different groups, places, operators and periods; performance under distribution shift; spillovers; whether improved averages conceal harm to vulnerable subgroups. (same source)

not_measured: dimension_scores: no EBA dimension score has been measured under this manifest yet; every entry score_status is NOT_MEASURED (missing is never recorded as 0)
source_version: the atlas records no per-entry version pins; source_version is null with source_version_status=NOT_RECORDED_IN_ATLAS_V1 for all 90 entries (open item for v2)

atlas_on_main: EVAL_LANDSCAPE_20261022.json and UPSTREAM_CODE_AUDIT_20261022.md are absent from origin/main at a883c1f12 although the published articles link them at the pinned commit; restoring the atlas file to the repo is an open hygiene item (this manifest pins its blob SHA-1 and content SHA-256 so the freeze does not depend on that restoration)
human_welfare: no entry in this manifest measures Anicca/Manager-caused human benefit; welfare evidence remains NOT_MEASURED (cf. EBA-v0 fictional demonstration, human-benefit field NOT_MEASURED)

released_effects_scorer: products/manager/manager_core/external_behavior_eval.py + products/manager/scripts/evaluate_external_behavior_benchmark.py cover only the released-effects study split (Intervention family); other families connect an existing scorer only where one fits (SSOT TODO 5), and none is connected by this manifest
tests_required_by_spec_not_in_this_artif: SSOT TODO 5 also requires fixture tests under products/manager/tests/ (hash mismatch, study leakage, missing != 0, baseline, subgroup/harm) and a second-environment reproduction of hash/denominator/aggregate. Those are code artifacts tracked with the scorer work, not part of this manifest freeze.
